text_zh: 流沙如瀑倾——汝祷未成，时已飞逝。
text_en: Hours spill like quicksilver—thy prayer unfinished, time already fled.

text_zh: 每一击键皆有其价——铅字落下，流沙亦随之散去。
text_en: Every strike demands its price—with each glyph falls the sand of hours.

text_zh: 时之巨轮转速渐增，终将脱轨——汝祷愈缓，其势愈急。
text_en: The great wheel turns ever faster, until the axle breaks—thy prayer grows slow, its hunger swift.

text_zh: 震颤召来寒霜——铅字冰封，祷音寂灭。
text_en: Each tremor calls forth frost—lead glyphs freeze, and prayer falls silent.

text_zh: 汝之成功映照于镜——而镜中时沙倒流，逾时则尽失。
text_en: Thy success reflects in glass—yet mirror-time flows backward, and delay devours all.

text_zh: 时间之沙漏向下，所积结晶亦随之消散——引擎不喜久存之功。
text_en: The hourglass empties downward, and with it dissolves all crystalline accumulation—the Engine abhors lingering achievement.

text_zh: 单字所承之力不得逾越门槛——引擎为每铅字设下界限。
text_en: No single glyph may bear force beyond the threshold—the Engine sets bounds upon each leaden character.

text_zh: 门槛倍增，试炼加倍——引擎要求更深的虔诚。
text_en: The threshold doubles, the trial deepens—the Engine demands greater devotion.

text_zh: 每一祷击后，下一击力量渐弱——连祷之功反成重负。
text_en: After each strike, the next grows weaker—the strength of litany becomes its burden.

text_zh: 引擎收其应得之份——每铅字既成，其力便有所失。
text_en: The Engine claims its due portion—as each glyph forms, some of its power is lost.

text_zh:
「圣流渐涸，铅字失重」
引擎之血被汲取，铭文组如枯井——覆盖愈广，失血愈缓。
text_en:
"The sacred humours run thin, the leaden glyphs lose their weight"
The Engine's lifeblood seeps away. Wider coverage slows the drain.

text_zh:
「铅字如烛，逐一消隐」
圣字钉失其形体，一一归于虚无——祷击须疾，免其散灭。
text_en:
"The leaden glyphs fade like dying candles, one by one"
Sacred slugs lose their form to void. Strike swift lest they dissolve.

text_zh:
「字序颠倒，铅字错位」
圣字钉背叛其位——须照乱象而击，莫循本序。
text_en:
"The order breaks, the leaden glyphs betray their stations"
Sacred slugs abandon their posts. Strike the chaos, not the design.

text_zh:
「末字先行，首字殿后」
祷文倒流——从终点始，向起源归。逆道亦是道。
text_en:
"The final letter leads, the first follows behind"
The litany flows backward. From ending to beginning. The reverse path is still path.

text_zh:
「异符渗入，圣词破损」
符印寄生于词间——打击杂质，取其净字。污者亦须铭刻。
text_en:
"Strange marks infest between sacred words"
Parasitic symbols nest within. Strike the corruption with the clean. Even tainted letters must be inscribed.

text_zh: 幻影铅字混入真铸之流——其形若真，其音若谎。键徒若被蒙蔽，真祷反成污渎。
text_en: Phantom slugs mingle with true castings—their form appears real, their voice speaks lies. The deceived clavigerant finds prayer becomes blasphemy.

text_zh:
残余异文：RA-097 · 流沙侵蚀
归属意志：第 VIII 层 · 钟摆执政官
持续效应：受感染区域内，已铭刻之结晶流持续向地底渗漏。渗漏速率与当前积存量成正比。D级人员报告铭刻时"听见沙粒坠落声"。
附带现象：墙体出现细微裂纹，内有细砂溢出。
"—— 聚沙成塔，散沙入渊"
text_en:
Residual Anomaly: RA-097 · Sands of Erosion
Host Will: Layer VIII · The Pendulum Magistrate
Sustained Effect: Within infected zones, crystalline humour continuously seeps into the foundation. Seepage rate correlates with current accumulation. D-Class personnel report "hearing sand grains fall" during inscription.
Secondary Phenomena: Fine cracks appear in walls, leaking granular matter.
"—— What gathers as towers, scatters as dust"

text_zh:
残余异文：RA-155 · 封顶诅咒
归属意志：第 VI 层 · 量衡守护者
持续效应：单一词语所能承载之铭分受到未知上限束缚。超出部分自动湮没。D级人员描述为"铅字变轻，如同空壳"。
附带现象：铭刻时偶现蜡滴，疑似封印残留。
"—— 器满则溢，言尽则息"
text_en:
Residual Anomaly: RA-155 · Ceiling Curse
Host Will: Layer VI · The Measure-Keeper
Sustained Effect: Individual words bound by unknown upper limit on inscription capacity. Excess automatically nullified. D-Class describe lead type as "becoming light, like empty shells".
Secondary Phenomena: Occasional wax drips during inscription, suspected seal residue.
"—— When the vessel fills, it spills; when words end, they cease"

text_zh:
残余异文：RA-203 · 双重门槛
归属意志：第 XII 层 · 引擎意志核心
持续效应：收容基准值异常倍增。已观察到引擎铸印量相应加大，伴随低频震颤。D级人员报告"感觉门变高了，铅字变小了"。
附带现象：第XII层深处传来双重节拍敲击声。
"—— 门高者，路远也"
text_en:
Residual Anomaly: RA-203 · Twin Threshold
Host Will: Layer XII · Engine Will Core
Sustained Effect: Containment threshold anomalously doubled. Engine casting output observed to increase correspondingly, accompanied by low-frequency tremors. D-Class report "feeling the gate grew taller, the type smaller".
Secondary Phenomena: Double-beat hammering echoes from Layer XII depths.
"—— Higher gates demand longer roads"

text_zh:
残余异文：RA-081 · 递疲现象
归属意志：第 V 层 · 执事长
持续效应：连续铭刻过程中，后续词语之结晶流产出逐次衰减。D级人员报告"铅字越来越沉，手指发麻"。长期暴露导致铭刻意愿下降。
附带现象：使用区域空气中铅屑浓度异常升高。
"—— 初击如雷，再击如雨"
text_en:
Residual Anomaly: RA-081 · Diminishing Echo
Host Will: Layer V · The Archdeacon
Sustained Effect: During continuous inscription, subsequent words yield progressively reduced crystalline humour. D-Class report "type growing heavier, fingers numbing". Prolonged exposure reduces inscription willingness.
Secondary Phenomena: Abnormally elevated lead particle concentration in affected areas.
"—— First strike as thunder, second as rain"

text_zh:
残余异文：RA-129 · 引擎税收
归属意志：第 IX 层 · 铁账簿
持续效应：每次铭刻完成时，部分结晶流被未知机制抽取并导向引擎深处。抽取量恒定，与收容基准相关。D级人员报告铭刻后"总觉得少了什么"。
附带现象：深层管道内偶现金属流动声。
"—— 引擎索其应得，键徒献其当纳"
text_en:
Residual Anomaly: RA-129 · Engine Tithe
Host Will: Layer IX · The Iron Ledger
Sustained Effect: Upon inscription completion, portions of crystalline humour extracted by unknown mechanism and directed toward engine depths. Extraction amount constant, correlating with containment threshold. D-Class report feeling "something missing" post-inscription.
Secondary Phenomena: Occasional metallic flow sounds within deep conduits.
"—— The Engine claims its due, the Keybound renders their tithe"
